AI Video Creator (Remote, Full-Time)

Bedrock Society Adjusters

Países permitidosMéxico
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoInglés fluido
ExperienciaProven experience generating short-form and long-form AI video
Salario$800 USD/month base + up to $400 USD/month bonuses (~$15,680 MXN/month)
HorarioFull-time (8 hours/day, set schedule)
Tipo de contrataciónFull-time, Permanent
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Create daily short-form and long-form AI videos with multiple characters and storytelling for a US public adjusting firm using tools like HeyGen, Kling, Runway, and ElevenLabs.

Funciones principales

  • Produce short-form and long-form AI video scenes daily using HeyGen, Kling, Runway, and ElevenLabs.
  • Craft compelling stories, dialogue, and clean captions tailored for American audiences.
  • Track, manage, and advise on social media performance and engagement.

Requisitos

  • Proven portfolio generating both short-form and long-form AI video.
  • Fluent spoken and written English.
  • Own computer, reliable internet, quiet workspace, and discipline for daily delivery.

Beneficios

  • $800 USD/month base salary paid twice a month.
  • Up to $400 USD/month in performance bonuses (up to $1,200 USD/month total).
  • 100% remote, full-time permanent role.
